thread:
ivana: Incoming pen-test intake: assessor requests 1h auth log slice + bundle of app logs. No DB dumps. We need ops lead and a clear escrow flow for artifacts.
noah: I can be ops lead. Proposal: create per-bundle DEK, wrap it with CMK using EncryptionContext {"pt-bundle":"<id>"}, upload bundle, then create a KMS Grant constrained to that EncryptionContext so assessor can only decrypt that bundle's DEK.
ravi: Sounds good. Manifest should be tiny: object, sha256, wrapped_dek_kms_key, grant_arn, presign_ttl, uploader, signature_method. Include allowed-operations note (Decrypt-only via grant).
ivana (sic): note: please sanitize logs first (remove PII, obfuscate IPs to /24, strip query strings). Security must sign-off the sanitized sample before any handoff.
noah: Upload flow (short): generate DEK, encrypt with CMK + EncryptionContext pt-bundle=id, upload tar.gz to staging s3, write manifest.json and KMS-sign it, create grant with EncryptionContextSubset, presign object for 1h, post manifest and grant ARN here.
kms-bot: KMS tip: use create-grant with --constraints EncryptionContextSubset to scope Decrypt to the bundle context. Schedule revoke after TTL via automation. Example: aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-logs --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-auditor --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"pt-bundle":"bld-007"}
ravi: Retest cadence: prefer 7 calendar days after remediation. If remediation increases privileges or attack surface, freeze deploys for the affected service and escalate to #incidents.
noah: I'll post the presign + grant ARN when upload completes and monitor S3/KMS access events.
ivana: small checklist for handoff: sanitized sample sign-off, manifest.sha256, manifest.signature (KMS), grant ARN, presign TTL, assessor contact. React :thumbsup: to ack.
ravi: :thumbsup: acked.
noah: :thumbsup: will post artifacts tonight.
kms-bot: Automation note: scheduled revoke attached to manifest metadata after create-grant completes.
